text:
**STEP 1 - Scene:** This is a grilled meat plate with a salad and corn on the cob. It has charred meat slices (pork or beef), grilled zucchini, spinach leaves, cherry tomatoes, cubes of feta-like cheese, two pieces of corn, some green beans or asparagus, and a light oil dressing.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** The plate is a white square dinner plate, about 23 cm per side. Its area is 23 × 23 ≈ 529 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:**
- Grilled meat slices
- Grilled zucchini
- Spinach
- Cherry tomatoes
- Feta cubes
- Corn on the cob (2 pieces)
- Green beans or asparagus
- Oil dressing

**STEP 4 - Area (percent of plate):**

| Item | Share of plate |
|---|---|
| Meat | 15% |
| Zucchini | 5% |
| Spinach | 15% |
| Tomatoes | 2% |
| Feta | 4% |
| Corn | 12% |
| Beans | 3% |
| **Total covered** | **~56%** |

This matches the photo, where the plate rim and much of the surface are visible.

**STEPS 5–7 - Volume, grams and energy:**

| Item | Area (cm²) | Height (cm) | Volume (ml) | Density (g/ml) | Grams | kcal/100 g | kcal |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Meat | 79 | 2 | 159 | ~0.85 (pieces with gaps) | 135 | 230 | 311 |
| Zucchini | 26 | 1.5 | 40 | 0.6 | 24 | 50 | 12 |
| Spinach | 79 | 2 | 159 | 0.15 | 24 | 23 | 6 |
| Cherry tomatoes | 11 | 2 | 21 | 0.6 | 13 | 18 | 2 |
| Feta | 21 | 1.5 | 32 | 0.9 | 28 | 265 | 74 |
| Corn | 63 | 4 | 254 | 0.6 | 152 gross, ~100 edible | 96 | 96 |
| Beans | 16 | 1 | 16 | 0.6 | 10 | 30 | 3 |
| Oil dressing | – | – | – | – | ~8 | 884 | 71 |

The corn weight includes the inedible cob, so I counted only about 100 g of kernels.

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** The total is about 342 g edible and roughly 575 kcal. That is plausible for a moderately filled plate holding meat, salad and two corn pieces.
